definitions.explanation: An examination held at fixed intervals, especially the midterm and final exams in Japanese schools. Also used for regularly scheduled professional or medical examinations.

examples.japanese: {来週|らいしゅう}は{定期試験|ていきしけん}だ。
examples.english: We have regular exams next week.

examples.japanese: {定期試験|ていきしけん}の{範囲|はんい}がまだ{発表|はっぴょう}されていない。
examples.english: The scope of the periodic exam hasn't been announced yet.

examples.japanese: {定期試験|ていきしけん}が{終|お}わったら、{友達|ともだち}と{遊|あそ}びに{行|い}く{約束|やくそく}をしている。
examples.english: I've promised to go out with friends after the regular exams are over.

notes:
A compound of {定期|ていき} (regular, periodic) and {試験|しけん} (examination, test). In Japanese schools, {定期試験|ていきしけん} typically refers to the midterm ({中間|ちゅうかん}) and final ({期末|きまつ}) exams held each term. Most Japanese middle and high schools hold these exams two to three times per year.

During {定期試験|ていきしけん} periods, club activities are usually suspended so students can focus on studying. Results significantly influence report card grades.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {定期試験|ていきしけん}の{勉強|べんきょう}: studying for regular exams
- {定期試験|ていきしけん}の{範囲|はんい}: exam scope
- {定期試験|ていきしけん}の{結果|けっか}: exam results
- {定期試験|ていきしけん}{期間|きかん}: exam period

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {中間試験|ちゅうかんしけん}: midterm exam — a specific type of {定期試験|ていきしけん}
- {期末試験|きまつしけん}: final exam — another specific type
- {実力|じつりょく}テスト: achievement test — tests overall ability, not tied to a specific unit of study
- {小|しょう}テスト: quiz — shorter, less formal test covering recent material
